info.description: Bounded native simulator subset of the official App Engine Admin API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Methods follow the official App Engine Admin API v1 paths; long-running operations complete synchronously and stay readable through apps.operations.get/list. Only the configured project owner may call a method; this is not Google IAM. The application cannot be deleted, as in App Engine. Versions run python312 in the standard environment only. Deployment copies Python sources from Cloud Storage objects of the configured project (deployment.zip or deployment.files); main.py must define the WSGI callable app. Requests reach versions through the stored traffic split (IP, COOKIE or RANDOM) and firewall at /_simulator/providers/gcp/appspot/<hostname>/; each request runs once in a fresh sandbox with a 10 second deadline and no network.
info.title: App Engine Admin API (simulator)
